title: Wise Business Bank
intro: Wise lets you send, receive, and hold money in different currencies at real exchange rates with no hidden fees.
body: Wise is a UK-based financial-technology company (formerly known as TransferWise) that offers multi-currency accounts and international money transfers.
In the UK you can open a Wise account online, get local bank details for multiple currencies (including GBP, EUR, USD) and hold/send money in 40+ currencies.
It’s important: Wise is **not** a traditional full-bank (as of now) in the UK — it is regulated under the Electronic Money Regulations rather than a full banking licence.
You can get local bank details (sort code + account number) in GBP and other currencies — great if you receive international payments.
Very good for spending/travelling overseas: Use the Wise debit card in 140+ countries, spend in many currencies with minimal hidden fees or poor exchange-rates.
Transparent fees: you convert at the mid-market exchange rate with a small clear conversion fee (typically between ~0.35% and 2%) rather than large mark-ups.
Easy to open and manage: Online/ app first, you can set up your account in minutes, choose currencies, etc.
Send or receive money internationally, or hold multiple currencies,
Want more control and transparency over currency conversion and fees,
Then Wise is an excellent modern option. We recommend it because it offers features that many traditional banks either don’t provide or charge much more for.
Because Wise is not a full bank in the UK, your deposits are not covered by the UK deposit-protection scheme (FSCS) (as you would get with a full UK bank).
Some users report issues with account verification, especially if their address or residency changes. For example:
“Even if you keep it for a while, you’ll definitely be asked to provide proof of residency … If your home country is not supported by Wise you’ll definitely run into issues.”
For business accounts (especially UK businesses), there have been reports about tougher onboarding or restrictions.
If you rely on cash deposits? Wise does not support cash/cheque deposits in the UK. Only online transfers.
